newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Gillette rated a buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Gillette rated a buy.

text.p: - Salomon Brothers Inc analyst Carol Warner said in a research report she maintains a buy rating on Gillette Co.
- The stock was trading up 3/8 at 73-1/4 on the New York Stock Exchange in late afternoon trade.
- Warner said the stock could trade up to $90 due to strong market share, global leadership, double-digit growth, and higher operating margins of 20 percent.
- Gillette has made several acquisitions in recent years which have either strengthened existing product lines or served as an entry into new markets.

- "In a nutshell, Gillette is a premier consumer company from many angles and one which its competitiors strive to emulate. As a result, we believe the shares should continue to trade at a premium to the group," Warner said in her report.
